acu_83214604ab.speaker: acu
acu_83214604ab.text: If I find yours, it's mine.

acu_8de2e96bf7.speaker: acu
acu_8de2e96bf7.text: Piscine rule number one: no AirPods during exams.

acu_afd99c4b31.speaker: acu
acu_afd99c4b31.text: Remember: cheating is -42. Losing AirPods is just sad.

acu_d3dd869222.speaker: acu
acu_d3dd869222.text: Also, your hoodie has trailing whitespace. Fix it.

chloe_91180fadde.speaker: chloe
chloe_91180fadde.text: Bring a sleeping bag and lower your expectations.

karim_05e5db88e2.speaker: karim
karim_05e5db88e2.text: Yo Mano. Want a game of babyfoot?

karim_13c70b5073.speaker: karim
karim_13c70b5073.text: Take? I FOUND it. Finders keepers. BDE rules.

karim_286246b20b.speaker: karim
karim_286246b20b.text: I dropped it at the lost & found, the Voltaire reception.

karim_3c18197266.speaker: karim
karim_3c18197266.text: Fine. Thing is... I don't have it anymore.

karim_88ec19846a.speaker: karim
karim_88ec19846a.text: Come back when you've trained, little man.

karim_9dad9012ee.speaker: karim
karim_9dad9012ee.text: But I'm a fair man. Beat me at babyfoot. First to 3.

karim_ab12a0a696.speaker: karim
karim_ab12a0a696.text: No? Then stop blocking my light.

karim_e07f524b01.speaker: karim
karim_e07f524b01.text: Scared? I get it. I'm very good.

madame_2d50fdd7f1.speaker: madame
madame_2d50fdd7f1.text: No coffee, no lost & found. That is the law.

madame_390cd578a7.speaker: madame
madame_390cd578a7.text: Go. Enjoy your music. Let me enjoy my coffee.

madame_48be36e386.speaker: madame
madame_48be36e386.text: Find yours. Don't touch the director's.

madame_5187430a40.speaker: madame
madame_5187430a40.text: Karim's earbud? Oh, honey. Look at this box.

madame_52807d1664.speaker: madame
madame_52807d1664.text: M scratch, chewed stem... gross. Yes, that one is yours.

madame_6c4ac9d3be.speaker: madame
madame_6c4ac9d3be.text: You have money. The machine is RIGHT THERE.

madame_7089749e15.speaker: madame
madame_7089749e15.text: That's the rule. I just made it.

madame_8ac8ea304f.speaker: madame
madame_8ac8ea304f.text: The box opens for people who bring me coffee.

madame_a1158dd76d.speaker: madame
madame_a1158dd76d.text: Lost something? Tell me WHO brought it here and maybe I'll look.

madame_c448ef913c.speaker: madame
madame_c448ef913c.text: The machine ate my coins and I have NOT had my coffee.

madame_d3e5d0c9f6.speaker: madame
madame_d3e5d0c9f6.text: Students lose about 37 AirPods a week here.

madame_e2857c7cc8.speaker: madame
madame_e2857c7cc8.text: Meet me at the Voltaire reception. Bring your good energy.

prof_3ffc9751c6.speaker: prof
prof_3ffc9751c6.text: Your AirPod? I confiscate phones, not earbuds.

prof_be7c7ab0da.speaker: prof
prof_be7c7ab0da.text: Shortest path to it: not my problem.

prof_c6838e0c86.speaker: prof
prof_c6838e0c86.text: Class is over, Mano. You slept through the whole Dijkstra lecture.

student2_42b2cad945.speaker: student2
student2_42b2cad945.text: I have forgotten what the sun looks like.

student3_42fa8c1252.speaker: student3
student3_42fa8c1252.text: The salle machine smells like 72 hours of piscine.

student3_e3c64b7e0f.speaker: student3
student3_e3c64b7e0f.text: We do our SPE project here.

theo_b0e4f235b1.speaker: theo
theo_b0e4f235b1.text: Ian and Silvia have been arguing about pastries for forty minutes.

theo_d83c59d38f.speaker: theo
theo_d83c59d38f.text: Karim keeps bragging about "a free AirPod". Weird flex.

theo_e6bc6e155e.speaker: theo
theo_e6bc6e155e.text: These steps are the best seats on campus. Free shade, free drama.

waiting_0f32da658f.speaker: waiting
waiting_0f32da658f.text: I have been waiting for the accueil since 9:00.

yanis_0fac0844ab.speaker: yanis
yanis_0fac0844ab.text: If you see a white earbud on the floor, it's probably mine. Or yours. Or everyone's.

yanis_52fd2df415.speaker: yanis
yanis_52fd2df415.text: Moulinette results drop at midnight. I am not okay.

yanis_d5800b7757.speaker: yanis
yanis_d5800b7757.text: The ACUs took my sleep schedule and never gave it back.
